name: KS Woodcraft LLC
old_description: We operate a custom wood furniture shop that specializes in hand crafting Rustic, Modern, Farmhouse and Contemporary wood furniture. We use a variety of solid hardwoods that are domestic and foreign.
about:
KS Woodcraft LLC is a family-owned and operated custom wood furniture shop based in McKinney, Texas, within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. The company describes itself as a small business built around handcrafted production, though no founding year or founder names are disclosed publicly.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind tables and furniture pieces in styles that include rustic farmhouse, modern industrial, contemporary, trestle, round, and reclaimed designs. All items are handcrafted from solid domestic hardwoods sourced locally as well as exotic imported species, and the company also works with reclaimed lumber salvaged from the historic McKinney Cotton Mill. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

KS Woodcraft serves residential, commercial, and office clients, inviting local customers to visit the shop for design consultations. The business emphasizes a collaborative process in which the buyer provides input throughout the build, aiming to deliver furniture that fits the exact size, shape, and finish the space requires.

The company positions its work as an alternative to mass‑market retailers that rely on veneers and lower‑grade materials. Its stated motto — “Always make furniture seem like the room was built around it” — reflects a focus on bespoke, heirloom‑quality construction rather than standardized inventory.
